title: Dil Chota Mat Karo
body:
dil chota mat karo wo bulayenge karbala
maula hussain sab ko dikhayenge karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
sun kar areeza ghazi ne paigham hai diya
maula hussain sab ko dikhayenge karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
fehrist mujhse maang rahe thay mere imam
likhwa diye hai maula ko tum sab ke maine naam
baaqi hai bas batool ki beti ka faisla
maula hussain sab ko dikhayenge karbala
dil chota mat karo...
<<DIVIDER>>
ankhein tumhari sach hai ke pur aab hai bahot
wo khud bhi tumse milne ko betaab hai bahot
ek baar dekho dil se to de kar unhe sada
maula hussain sab ko dikhayenge karbala
dil chota mat karo...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghaafil nahi kisi se bhi ibne abu turab
misle mujaab aayega har ek ka jawab
labbaik ya hussain ki dete raho sada
maula hussain sab ko dikhayenge karbala
dil chota mat karo...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo reh gaya watan mein usay kehna gham na kar
khud pursa lene aayenge shabbir tere ghar
bas shaah se ziyarat e ashoor maangna
maula hussain sab ko dikhayenge karbala
dil chota mat karo...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehna tum us se jis ne wasail ka tha kaha
tera to rizq shaah ne kab ka badha diya
le aaye apne bachon ko is saal karbala
maula hussain sab ko dikhayenge karbala
dil chota mat karo...
<<DIVIDER>>
farzand e fatema ki badi bargaah hai
akbar ke baba jaan ki sab par nigaah hai
kab hai wahan pe farq ameer o ghareeb ka
maula hussain sab ko dikhayenge karbala
dil chota mat karo...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala jo laa na saka waledain ko
wo jaanta nahi abhi aaqa hussain ko
roze pe unke aaye bina mar gaye to kya
maula hussain sab ko dikhayenge karbala
dil chota mat karo...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo matami jawan hai akbar ke pursa daar
un sab ka khaas rehta hai maula ko intezar
maango jawano waasta de kar jawan ka
maula hussain sab ko dikhayenge karbala
dil chota mat karo...
<<DIVIDER>>
paison se kaun kehte hai jaate hai karbala
aata hai bas wo jisko bulaate hai karbala
jis jis ne bhi yaqeen hai is baat par rakha
maula hussain sab ko dikhayenge karbala
dil chota mat karo...
<<DIVIDER>>
nazdeek jab hussain ki turbat ke jaoge
niyyat karo sakina ki ghurbat sunaoge
sun'ne ko apni laadli beti ka marsiya
maula hussain sab ko dikhayenge karbala
dil chota mat karo...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise bayan ho sughra ki haalat ajeeb thi
bemaar apne ammu se aakar lipat gayi
sughra se ye tasalli mein abbas ne kaha
maula hussain sab ko dikhayenge karbala
dil chota mat karo...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas is ki baat ka rakh lena tum bharam
tere bharose chalta hai sajjad ka qalam
is ne to de diya hai zamane ko aasra
maula hussain sab ko dikhayenge karbala
dil chota mat karo...
author: Mir Sajjad Mir
